title: Euphoria's Overlay
description: Euphoria's Overlays: Simple Overlay that makes your game look more slick for PVP
body:
# Euphoria's Overlay

This Simple Minecraft texture pack that will make your game look more smooth for pvp.
(The texture pack may say "Broken or incompatible" if your not on 1.21.11, but it will still work for 1.21+)

(This is pack idea was from my friend Euphoriaaa.)

# What the pack has
- Small Totem
- Side Shield
- No flashing hearts
- Dotted Crosshair

## Installation
**(⚠️ This may be different on other operating systems ⚠️)**
1. **Windows/Win + R**, type **%appdata%**.
2. Open the **.minecraft** folder.
3. Find the **resourcepacks** folder and open it.
4. Paste the resource pack/file there.
 
⬇

**Easier Method**
 (May not work on some launchers, **does work** on most)
1. In the Minecraft menu, open the resource packs screen.
2. Then Simply Drag the resource pack onto your screen.

   After you drag it onto your screen it may say something like, 
!["Do you want to add the following packs to Minecraft?"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/243e222d20ba75112c53906cb29eb5208a908ff0.gif)
Click Yes on that popup.
